issue: प्रभु लंका विजय करावो: करावो is an imperative form, but the stanza tells past deeds (पूजन की, रचि डारो, पार किया).
our reading: Lord, you brought about the victory at Laṅkā
alternatives: Lord, bring about victory (as at Laṅkā)

issue: श्री कृष्ण की विजय सुनो: the sense is unclear in a prayer to Viśvakarmā; विनय ('plea', as in stanza 2) would read more easily, but both witnesses have विजय.
alternatives: श्री कृष्ण की विनय सुनो: hear (my) plea, as (you heard) Kṛṣṇa's
